title: Book Three · Chapter 23: A Place in the Photo
story:
The following Friday brings the first cold wind of winter.

The class goes outside for a photo. Ronan has shorter hair now. He keeps touching the back of his neck.

Kai pulls his own collar up.

“Same cold?” he asks.

“Same barber.”

Near the steps, the teacher asks the taller students to stand at the back. A photographer waits beside his camera.

Ronan starts toward the far end of the row.

“Here,” Kai calls.

There is a space beside him. Ronan moves into it. On Kai's other side stands his friend from the football games.

Anna is nearer the front with two girls. She looks back once, then turns to help her friend straighten a collar.

The photographer looks at the rows.

“A little closer at this end.”

Ronan takes half a step sideways. His shoulder touches Kai's coat.

“Too close?” he asks.

“No. You stop the wind.”

“You can pay me later.”

Kai grins. The teacher asks them to look forward.

A boy at the far end stands on his toes. Someone behind him tells him to stop. For a moment, the last row moves from side to side.

The photographer lowers his camera and waits.

“Feet flat, please.”

Everyone settles down. Ronan looks toward the camera. The wind lifts the hair above his eyes, but it no longer falls across them.

“Ready.”

The camera clicks.

“One more.”

This time, Kai's friend whispers something. Kai tries not to laugh. Ronan sees his cheeks move and nearly laughs too.

The camera clicks again.

The teacher lets them go. The rows break apart, and everyone heads toward the warm building.

“What did he say?” Ronan asks Kai.

“That the ball should be in the photo.”

“Under your shirt?”

Kai laughs. “It wanted to join the class.”

At the stairs, Anna comes beside them.

“Were you smiling?” she asks.

“At the wrong time,” Ronan says.

“Then it may be a good photo.”

She goes ahead to meet her friends. Kai stops at the drinking water, and Ronan carries on upstairs.

In the classroom, he puts his cold hands under his arms. Through the window, he can see the empty place beside the steps.

On the first morning, he knew no names there. Today he knows the voices on the stairs before the others come in.

Kai drops into his chair. Anna opens her notebook. The teacher shuts the classroom door against the wind.

Ronan takes out his pencil. At home, Leo's two letters are safe in his drawer. His latest letter is still on its way to the other city.

Beside him, Anna asks for the ruler. He moves it across the desk, and the lesson starts.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

photo＝照片；row＝一排；photographer＝摄影师；on one's toes＝踮起脚尖。

## 理解问题

1. 班级合影时，Kai怎样让Ronan进入队伍？Anna主要和谁站在一起？
2. 本章到了什么季节？Ronan新学校的人际生活和第一天相比有什么变化？

## 读句子

**His shoulder touches Kai's coat.**

拆开看：His shoulder / touches / Kai's coat.

他的肩膀／碰到／Kai的外套。
